mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_field (field_code, table_code, field_name, field_type, label, is_required, form_component, validate_rule, sort) VALUES (#{fieldCode}, #{tableCode}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldType}, #{label}, #{isRequired}, #{formComponent}, #{validateRule}, #{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_field SET field_name = #{fieldName}, field_type = #{fieldType}, label = #{label}, is_required = #{isRequired}, form_component = #{formComponent}, validate_rule = #{validateRule}, sort = #{sort} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM metadata_field WHERE table_code = #{tableCode} AND field_code = #{fieldCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_field WHERE table_code = #{tableCode} AND field_code = #{fieldCode}
